data_fields.name: sfx_priority
data_fields.donor_constant: lower = more important; pldeth 32, itemup 78, posit1 98, sawidl 118, tink 60

data_fields.name: map8_no_clip
data_fields.donor_constant: gamemap 8 skips clip and plays at full volume

best_idea: Cap live voices; when a new cue is more important than the least important live voice, stop that voice, otherwise drop the new cue; one voice per emitter; singleton cues restart.
decision_why: The voice cap, priority steal and per-emitter rule suit a client-side cue pool, but the donor releases game-side voices every frame in the shipped SNDSERV build and its mixer ignores priority; take the shape, fix the defects.
acceptance: Client test with a fake clock: cap 4, six cues in one frame keep the four most important voices; stop(slot) silences that voice the same frame; voices stay counted until their end tick.
